chapter: Family and early memories of Jelly
title: What she knows of Jelly's schooling and where her information came from
summary: She knows nothing of his education; her family information comes from an aunt by marriage, Viola Haynes.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: he would have gone to school here, and he went to St. Joseph's University and took music, he told about it.

Well, I don't know anything about his education here, because, you see, I was the baby, and my grandmother never discussed anything with me. And all of this information that I'm giving you now, I got out of an aunt by marriage. My uncle's wife told me. My sister told me just a smidgen. She wouldn't tell me too much. And then my aunt had died here three years ago. We went out on the 4th of July one time, just the two of us. What was her name? Viola Haynes. Uh-huh. She was married—she admitted to John Haynes, and she just died a few years ago. Well, we went out on the lake and sat there, and she talked about everything she thought I should know. And I appreciate her for that. I have pictures
